name: fundhunter
description: Turkish investment fund explorer. core.js is the headless logic module; ui.js is the browser layer. Data is refreshed daily by GitHub Actions into data/.

scripts.test: node --test test/core-test.mjs test/analytics-test.mjs test/pdf-test.mjs test/portfolio-test.mjs test/quotes-test.mjs test/sw-test.mjs test/collapse-test.mjs
scripts.build:data: npm run fetch && npm run fetch:benchmarks && npm run fetch:crashes && npm run fetch:sectors && npm run fetch:stocks && npm run fetch:cpi && npm run fetch:logos && npm run analytics
